messages:
sara: Kicking off progressive hydration for model `orca-v3-lite` in the catalog. Change window 14:00-16:00 PT. Plan: canary -> staggered ramp -> full. Posting rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orca-v3-lite-rollout

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by sara. Canary: 2% traffic at 14:00 PT, ramp to 20% over 30m, 60m monitoring window. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >30% or error rate >2%. Canary telemetry will be in #eng-runtime/telemetry.

olivia: Ran eval suite this morning — quality delta looks +0.6 BLEU-equivalent on our chat prompts, token cost +8% median. worth watching cost tag and route-level token counts.

kevin: Question: do we want to change fallback ordering to prefer `q-orca-v3` (quantized) over older `orca-v2` for cost reasons? Might reduce unit cost if safe.

matt: Heads up: `q-orca-v3` hasn't passed OOM stress on older 24GB machines. Risk of task evictions if we promote it as a global fallback. Suggest fallback ladder: 1) orca-v3-lite, 2) q-orca-v3 (only on 48GB pools), 3) orca-v2 for everything else.

release-manager: Agree with matt. Let's gate q-orca-v3 by node-capability. Also request we pin high-sensitivity tenants for the first hour. Add kill-switch command `/rollout terminate ${thread_ts}` if we hit rollback thresholds.

sara: Deploy checklist (will execute once canary is healthy):
```
- deploy-bot: start canary 2%
- collect p50/p95, error-rate, token-counts for 60m
- increase sampling for traces on /chat-stream and /summarize routes
- pinlist: add sensitive tenants -> orca-v2 for 1h
- if p95 <= baseline*1.15 and errors <1% -> ramp to 20% over 30m
- post rollout notes + changelog snippet
```

deploy-bot: Canary started at 14:00 PT. Initial traffic slice OK. Will report after 15m and at 60m.

deploy-bot: Canary status update (14:15): p95 +12% on /chat-stream for tenant `tenant-xyz`, overall errors 0.8%. Monitoring increased sampling for traces on that route.

olivia: Pause ramp please — want more trace samples for tenant-xyz. The +12% p95 is concentrated on long-chat sessions.

kevin: Recommend pinning tenant-xyz back to `orca-v2` immediately while we triage. Command: `pinlist add tenant-xyz orca-v2 --ttl 1h`

release-manager: Approved. sara, go ahead and pin. Notify infra if we need to repro on a staging 48GB node.

sara: Ran `pinlist add tenant-xyz orca-v2 --ttl 1h`. Deploy-bot confirms. Pausing further ramp until telemetry stabilizes. Will post root-cause updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: tenant-xyz pinned to orca-v2. Ramp paused. Canary hold in effect. To terminate rollout: `/rollout terminate 1965432100`. To resume: `/rollout resume 1965432100`.
